column1: # Noun-type words from the big HSK dataset that look like one word but are deliberately written as separate words in our sentences.
# tools/check-lexicon.py fails when a dataset noun/time/place word is split in a sentence and is in neither this file nor lexicon-words.tsv.

column2: in 两个人 / 每个人 it is measure word 个 + 人, not 个人 (an individual)
verb + noun (there is someone), written yǒu rén
adverb 不 + 太, written bú tài (the dataset tags it as a name by mistake)
verb + aspect particle 着, written chuān zhe
才 (adverb) and 能 (modal verb) are two words: 才能说 is cái néng shuō
上 + measure word 个 + 月, a time phrase written shàng ge yuè
in 二十年前 it is 年 + 前 (twenty years ago), not 年前 (the days before the New Year); written nián qián
